about: Stops one account signing in while an incident about it is worked. The containment step for an account somebody else may be using.
credential: An API token made by an administrator whose only role is one that can suspend users and clear their sessions — a custom role with those two permissions, or Help Desk Administrator scoped to the groups concerned. Not the token a connector reads with: that one is made by a read-only administrator so that it cannot do this.

action.name: okta-suspend-user
action.title: Suspend an Okta account

target.what: an Okta user id, as the system log names the actor

action.effect: The account cannot sign in to Okta or to anything it signs in to through Okta. Sessions already open elsewhere are not closed by this; clear them as well.
action.reverts: Unsuspending puts the account back as it was: same password, same factors, same groups.
